# StocksToTrade

> > StocksToTrade is a trading education and stock scanning platform featuring insights from Tim Bohen, Pre-Market Prep analysis, and resources for day traders focused on momentum stocks, meme stocks, and technical analysis strategies.

The platform provides comprehensive trading education ranging from beginner guides on stock order types and IPOs to advanced technical analysis patterns like RSI and head-and-shoulders formations. StocksToTrade emphasizes risk management, trading psychology, and practical stock scanning techniques for identifying momentum and dividend growth opportunities across NYSE, NASDAQ, and OTC markets.

## Key Topics

- Tim Bohen
- Pre-Market Prep
- Day trading strategies
- Momentum stocks
- Meme stocks (GameStop, BBBY)
- Technical analysis (RSI, chart patterns)
- Risk management and tolerance
- Stock order types (market, limit, stop-loss)
- IPOs and listing requirements
- Short covering and short squeezes
- Stock scanning techniques
- Trading psychology and mental health
- NYSE and NASDAQ markets
- OTC and pink sheets trading
- Dividend growth investing
